name: cash.group_balances

list.description: List native group balance snapshots in verified USD-equivalent scope.

parameters.name: group-code
parameters.description: Optional native group codes; repeated values select an exact set.

parameters.name: equi-currency
parameters.description: Native equivalent-currency scope; only USD is verified.

purpose: Inspect native group balances and independently timed member observations without summing original currencies.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native group identity; string and integer types stay distinct.

fields.name: userGroupCode
fields.meaning: Native group code used for exact group selection.

fields.name: currentBalance
fields.meaning: Native group current balance in requested equivalent scope; no summing or conversion.

fields.name: forecastBalance
fields.meaning: Native forecast balance, independent of current balance.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Native group date; does not establish independent member observation times.

fields.name: memberList
fields.meaning: Native members with original currencyCode balances and equivalent balances in requested USD scope.

fields.name: equiCurrency
fields.meaning: Native currency field when returned; absent remains absent.

fields.name: forecastTime
fields.meaning: Native member forecast observation time when returned; absent remains absent.

identity_description: Native id identifies each pool; string and integer identities remain distinct.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant; GET /bankAccountGroupQuery.json with JSON bankAccountManageUnitQueryVO and pageSize=100, zero-based rowStart.
Verified equivalent-currency request scope is USD; optional native userGroupCode is a JSON array.
Inner result.success must be true and result.count must agree with top-level count. No native page echo; completeness requires stable totals, arrivals and unique identities.
Retain every native field, exact amount, original type and null/empty/zero distinction without historical whitelisting.
Original member balances use currencyCode; equivalent member balances use the requested USD scope. Native original currencies are never summed.
Member observation times are independent; gmtModified and capture time do not establish balance observation time. Missing equiCurrency or forecastTime fields stay absent.
Offline group-code filters select exact codes from saved records; no new equivalent-currency scope is acquired offline.
